parsed.doc_summary: LAHD RSO rent increase calculator page: states the 3% annual allowable RSO increase (7/1/2025–6/30/2026), ending of the utility add-on percentage as of 2026-02-02, and RSO/SCEP surcharge pass-throughs. State 30-day notice reference for increases under 10%.

rules.title: Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance annual allowable increase
rules.requirement: For RSO units, the annual allowable rent increase is 3% for July 1, 2025 through June 30, 2026. Beginning February 2, 2026, landlords can no longer add any additional percentage for utilities. RSO and SCEP surcharges may be passed through only after unit registration and written notice.
rules.citation: L.A. Mun. Code ch. XV, art. 1 (L.A. Mun. Code § 151.00 et seq.)
rules.quoted_span: Beginning February 2, 2026, a landlord can no longer include any additional percentage increase for utilities.
rules.key_value: 3% annual increase (7/1/2025–6/30/2026); no utility add-on from 2026-02-02
rules.effective_date_note: Date of the no-utility-add-on change per LAHD; the 3% figure applies to the 7/1/2025–6/30/2026 period. A landlord association reportedly published 2026-01-24.
rules.coverage_conditions: Units subject to the RSO; check ZIMAS.
rules.interaction: Local RSO governs instead of state Tenant Protection Act cap for covered units.
rules.conflict_note: Other sources may give 2026-01-24 as the effective date of the new formula; this LAHD page says 2026-02-02.

unverifiable_exemptions: RSO coverage depends on building date (generally pre-10/1/1978 certificate of occupancy) and exemptions not shown on this page; verify via ZIMAS
